profiles: Signed to Hospital in 2010; explore the shift from Cross the Line to Zeitgeist, then the orchestral Red Bull Symphonic project.
Firestarter’s crossover sound and its later Andy C remix provide an entry point into their catalogue.
Gold Dust appeared in several versions; the 2012 Shy FX re-edit reached number 22 in the UK.
The label’s retrospective places Source Direct among artists associated with the 1990s Speed club scene.

Compare the debut album and Untrue, both released through Hyperdub. The latter’s anniversary edition uses a stripped-back version of Burial’s original hand-drawn artwork. Begin with Archangel, then compare the texture and atmosphere of Near Dark.

Sam Shepherd released Elaenia in 2015, and Crush followed on Ninja Tune in 2019. The label describes a shift toward a more immediate, improvisation-led recording process using a Buchla synthesizer, following solo sets supporting The xx in 2017.
The Brain project debuted on Planet E in 2020. Its 2026 remaster offers a starting point for exploring Dear’s other projects, including Audion, False and Jabberjaw.
Co-founder of Arms & Legs alongside Daniel Steinberg. Explore The Dust and the label’s house and techno catalogue.
Saul Milton and Will Kennard charted with Love’s Theme in 2005, reached the UK album top two with No More Idols and earned their first singles chart number one with BACKBONE in 2024.
Nu:Tone and Logistics formed the collaborative project Nu:Logic. Their debut album in 2013 was revisited in a 2023 anniversary remix EP.
